s: strI, (aDomuKena gacCati, apa + gam + karttari qaH, striyAM wAp .) ApagA । nadI । ityamarawIkAyAM BarataH । (srotasvatI dvIpavatI sravantI nimnagApagA ityamaraH .)
v: strI apagacCati nizyandate apa + gama--qa । ApagAyAm nadyAm । apayAnakarttari tri॰ ।
m: अप-गा f. = आप-गा, L.
अप-√ 1. गा to go away, vanish, retire (with abl.), VS. &c.

a: अपगारं --गोरं — ind. Having raised or lifted up; अस्यपगोरं-गारं युध्यंते P. VI. 1. 53 Sk. lifting their swords.

v: avya॰ apa + gurI--udyamane Ramul eca Acca vA । udyamyetyarTe “asyapagAram asyavagoraM veti” si॰ kO॰ ।
m: अप-गारम् or अप-गोरम्, ind. disapproving, threatening (?), Pāṇ. vi, 1, 53.
अप-√ गै to break off singing, cease to sing, GopBr.; Vait.
अप-√ 2. गॄ Intens. part. -जर्गुराण (mfn.) (Gmn. & NBD.) devouring, RV. v, 29, 4.
अप-गूढ mfn. hidden, concealed, RV.
अप-गूहमान mfn. hiding, AV. xix, 56, 2
अप-ग mf(आ)n. going away, turning away from (abl.), AV. i, 34, 5 (cf. अन्-अपग)
a: अपग — a. Going, turning away. --गा A river (wrongly for आपगा).
अपगंडः — One who has attained his {{mojority->majority||20210104|Dr. Sampada Savardekar and Jim Funderburk|https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/20|}}; see अपोगंड.

v: pu॰ gaRqovfdDo vEparItyArTakenApaSabdena prA॰ sa॰ । atibAle apogaRqa iti hEma॰ । apogaRqaSabde vivaraRaM dfSyam ।

m: अप-गल्भ mfn. wanting in boldness, embarrassed, perplexed, VS.; TS.
a: अपगल्भ — a. Ved. 1 Wanting in boldness, abortive. --2 Being on the side, lateral. --3 Separated from the oldest by one.

m: अप-√ गम् to go away, depart; to give way, vanish.
a: अपगम् — {c1c} P. 1 To go away, depart; pass away, elapse (as time); K. 73; तन्मुखाच्छायापगता H. 3; संपदो नापगच्छंति Pt. 3. 8. --2 To fall off or down; go away, vanish, disappear.

v: pu॰ apa + gama--BAve GaY na vfdDiH । apayAne apasaraRe । “nidrApagamahetuByo viboDaScetanAgama” iti sA॰ da॰ “purARapatrApagamAdanantaraM lateva sannanDamanojYapallaveti” raGuH ।
m: अप-गम m. going away
giving way
departure, death.
a: अपगमः, --मनं — 1 Going away or off, departure, separation; समागमाः सापगमाः H. 4. 65. --2 Falling off, going away, removal, disappearance; निमित्तमुद्दिश्य हि यः प्रकुप्यति भ्रुवंस तस्यापगमे प्रसीदति .. Pt. 1. 283; त्वत्संरोधापगगविशदैश्चंद्रपादैः Me. 70; पुराणपत्रापगमादनंतरं R. 3. 7; lapse, passing away; कतिपयदिवसापगमे K. 66, 193. --3 Death, decease.

m: अप-गमन n. id.

v: pu॰ apa + nindArTe gF--BAve ap । nindane । “anyadantarvedItyupakramya “aBigarApagarO” kAtyA॰ 13, 3, 3, “apagaronindeti” tadvyA॰ ।
m: अप-गर m. (√ 1. गॄ), reviler (special function of a priest at a sacrifice), PBr.; Lāṭy. &c. (cf. अभिगर.)
a: अपगरः — [अप-निंदार्थे गॄ भावे अप्] 1 Censure, reviling (निंदा); अभिगरापगरौ Kāty. --2 One who reviles or says what is disagreeable, reviler.

m: अप-गर्जित mfn. thunderless (as a cloud), Kathās.

s: tri, (apa + gam + karttari ktaH, apayAte palAyite ca .) mftaH । iti hemacandraH । gataH । dUrIBUtaH । yaTA, -- “tAponApagatastfzA na ca kfSA DUlo na DOtA tanoH” ityAdi vallAlasenaH ।
v: tri॰ apa + gama--karttari kta । apayAte palAyite ca । BAve GaY । tatrArTe pu॰ ।
m: अप-गत mfn. gone, departed, remote, gone off
dead, diseased.
a: अपगत — p. p. 1 Gone away, departed, passed away, gone off; being remote; oft. as first member of comp. in the sense of ‘free from’, ‘devoid of’; ˚अन्यव्यापाराः K. 43 having no other duties; ˚मत्सर 45; 47, 157, 164, 207, 211; ˚निमेषेण चक्षुषा 154 devoid of twinkling or winking; ˚मले मनसि 102. --2 Dead, deceased.

m: अपगत-कालक mfn. (a robe) free from black spots, Divyāv.
अप-गत—व्याधि mfn. one who has recovered from a disease.

a: अपगतिः — f. A bad fate (going to hell &c.); येन चापगतिर्भवेत् Pt. 2. 108.

m: अप-गृह्य mfn. being outside a house, ŚāṅkhGṛ.

v: pu॰ apa + guha--GaY । taroDAne gopane ca । “sa vidvAnapagohaM kaRInAmAvirBavanniti” f॰ 2, 15, 7, “apagohaM tiroBAvamiti” BAzyam ।
m: अप-गोह m. hiding-place, secret, RV. ii, 15, 7.
a: अपगोहः — Ved. A hiding place, disappearance, concealment.

m: अप-गोपुर mfn. without gates (as a town)
a: अपगोपुर — a. Deprived of its gateways (as a town).

m: अप-गोरण n. threatening Comm. on TS.
अप-ग्राम mfn. ejected from a village or community, ŚāṅkhŚr.
अप-√ ग्रह् to take away, disjoin, tear off.
अप-√ गुह् (Subj. 2. sg. P. -गूहस्, Ā. -गूहथास्; impf. 3. pl. अपागूहन्; aor. -अघुक्षत्) to conceal, hide, RV.; AV.
अप-√ गुर् to reject, disapprove, threaten, RV. v, 32, 6, &c.; to inveigh against any one: Intens. part. अप-जर्गुराण (see s.v. अप- √ 2. गॄ).
a: अपगुर् — {c6c} A. 1 To disapprove, reject. --2 To threaten, menace; revile, censure, reproach, rail at. --3 To deprive of.
